about: Saregama India Limited operates as an entertainment company in India and internationally. It operates in four segments: Music, Artist Management, Video, and Events. The Music segment engages in the manufacture and sale of music storage device through Carvaan, Music Card, Vinyl records, etc., as well as dealing with related music rights.
